rules: Prioritize clean architecture and MVVM pattern
Mandatory package structure: app/, core/, data/, domain/, presentation/, services/, di/ (using manual DI/Service Locator)
Do not use Hilt; rely on manual Dependency Injection (Constructor/Factory/Service Locator)
Use Use Cases/Interactors in Domain layer
Use StateFlow with immutable UI state in Presentation layer
Use Repository Pattern in Data layer
Firebase is the exclusive backend (Auth, Realtime DB, Firestore, Storage, FCM, Functions, App Check, Crashlytics, Remote Config)
Do not introduce hacks; prepare code for thorough unit and UI testing
Address system-wide resources (overlays, services) carefully to avoid memory and coroutine leaks
Use MobiAI Android skills focusing exclusively on Compose architecture and static code analysis
Strictly avoid executing ADB commands, device automation, or taking/analyzing screenshots; limit agent execution to inspecting, editing, and compiling local files
For any major changes or testing execution, explicitly ask the user for confirmation beforehand
